description: This Java class, ChangedTransactionDetail, manages a list of TransactionChangeData objects related to loan transaction reversals or creations. It provides methods to add, insert before existing, or remove transaction changes, helping track modifications to loan transactions.

classes.name: ChangedTransactionDetail
classes.description: Manages a list of transaction change data related to loan transactions, with methods to add, insert, and remove transaction change entries.

methods.name: addTransactionChange
methods.description: Adds a TransactionChangeData to the list, updating existing entries if matching transactions are found.

methods.name: addNewTransactionChangeBeforeExistingOne
methods.description: Inserts a new TransactionChangeData before a specified existing LoanTransaction in the list.

methods.name: removeTransactionChange
methods.description: Removes TransactionChangeData entries associated with a specified LoanTransaction.
